title: The boat photo in the wheelhouse
logline: A photo the shop framed in 2002 — a boat and its skipper — screwed to the wall of that boat's wheelhouse in 2023, the frame salt-swollen, the skipper old at the wheel beneath his young self. The page from the dock through the wheelhouse glass.

panels.composition: Through a fishing boat's wheelhouse window from the dock: an old skipper at the wheel beneath a salt-swollen framed photo of a young man and the same boat screwed to the wall.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen through a fishing boat's wheelhouse window from a dock, an old skipper at the wheel beneath a salt-swollen framed photo of a young man and the same boat screwed to the wall, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
